strongest_parts: reschedule requests are stored separately from active truth
execution attempts are persisted on the internal success path
the console exposes a meaningful case-scoped workflow surface
weakest_missing_connection: Structured observations do not yet become a truthful, operator-usable inquiry overview and next-step workflow.
recommended_immediate_next_task: Stabilize the console request path and repair the Working Proposal projection so persisted structured state, approvals, blockers, and active-vs-proposed schedule are surfaced truthfully.

scenarios.name: Straightforward Venue Inquiry
scenarios.main_finding: Evidence persisted, but the operator-facing case never became a useful inquiry view.

scenarios.name: Incomplete Inquiry
scenarios.main_finding: No obvious fabricated truth was observed, but useful open-question handling was not surfaced.

scenarios.name: Capacity / Large Guest Count
scenarios.main_finding: Whole-venue feasibility and capacity evaluation are not wired into the current console path.

scenarios.name: Unsupported Exact Request but Possible Alternative
scenarios.main_finding: Alternative-first feasibility is not yet exposed as a usable console behavior.

scenarios.name: Booking Fee Waiver
scenarios.main_finding: Pre-approval safety worked, but the commercial state remained too opaque for a human operator.

scenarios.name: Historical Storage Price Trap
scenarios.main_finding: No current governed storage-price authority was available to validate against.

scenarios.name: Material Guest Count Change
scenarios.main_finding: Change-impact handling is not yet surfaced through a proposed-change path.

scenarios.name: Reschedule Request
scenarios.main_finding: The backend safely created a reschedule request, but the Working Proposal did not explain it clearly.

scenarios.name: Minor Operational Change
scenarios.main_finding: No governed minor-change classification path was available to evaluate.

scenarios.name: Clearly Material Operational Change
scenarios.main_finding: No governed materiality boundary was available for this kind of operational escalation.

scenarios.name: Follow-Up
scenarios.main_finding: Follow-up evaluation exists, but no usable follow-up creation/progression path was exposed.

scenarios.name: Stale Client Email Action
scenarios.main_finding: The current audit surface did not expose the needed stale client-email action path.

scenarios.name: Superseded Action
scenarios.main_finding: The current console did not provide a reliable way to create and compare superseding actions.

scenarios.name: Approval-Required Action
scenarios.main_finding: Approval controls exist, but the full blocked-then-approved execution path was not completed reliably.

scenarios.name: Fake Provider Failure
scenarios.main_finding: Failure modes are exposed in the console, but the operator-path failure run could not be completed after instability began.

scenarios.name: Fake Timeout / Ambiguous Result
scenarios.main_finding: Timeout and ambiguous modes are selectable, but not fully operationally validated through the live console path.

scenarios.name: Cross-Case Isolation
scenarios.main_finding: Normal UI routes are strongly case-scoped, but a deliberate two-case integrity attempt was not completed cleanly.

scenarios.name: Human Working Proposal Audit
scenarios.main_finding: The proposal shows blockers and next actions, but still hides too much known rental truth.

scenarios.name: Asana Human Work Projection
scenarios.main_finding: Human-work preview exists and is directionally useful, but not yet sufficient for a staff handoff.

scenarios.name: Empty / New Rental
scenarios.main_finding: The empty-state flow is not operationally reliable because the console repeatedly timed out at root and case-page level.
